name: Tamil MP3 Downloader — V5 Unified Discovery & Library System

phases.title: Database Schema v4 Evolution & Data Models
key_deliverables: Schema v4 migration with 9 new relational tables
Zero alterations to existing songs table and downloads foundation
Deterministic SQLite connection management with reentrant RLock

phases.title: Fast Search & Composable Filter Engine
key_deliverables: FTS5 full-text search with automatic sync triggers
ComposableFilterEngine with SQL AST generation
Server-side pagination and sub-15ms search performance

phases.title: Movie Catalog & Tracklist Discovery
key_deliverables: Regional scraper movie ingestion pipeline
Movie catalog and detailed tracklist views
Deduplicated bulk 'Download Missing' with DownloadPlanner integration

phases.title: Artist, Composer & Actor Exploration
key_deliverables: Multi-role artist entity recognition (Music Directors, Singers, Actors)
Artist exploration cards with role filters
Dedicated artist detail view with discography breakdowns

phases.title: Curated Charts & Top 100 Feeds
key_deliverables: Periodic chart snapshots with historical ranking and trend indicators
Apple Music / iTunes Tamil Top Hits & curated Tamil evergreen classics
Bulk and individual chart entry download execution

phases.title: Playlists, Ratings & User Collections
key_deliverables: Custom user playlist CRUD and arbitrary song reordering
1-5 star user song ratings and favorite toggling
External playlist import from Spotify/YouTube with canonical deduplication

phases.title: Artwork Disk Caching & Rich UI Polish
key_deliverables: Multi-tier artwork cache (in-memory LRU + SHA256 disk cache)
Physical MP3 ID3 APIC cover art extraction via mutagen
Procedural high-contrast gradient fallback generator
Design system typography aliases and cross-view hover highlights
